children: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (KRX:000660) is at the center of AI-driven momentum—signing an LOI with OpenAI for massive DRAM supply while analysts lift targets on HBM demand, a 2x SKHU ETF debuts to amplify exposure, regulators warn leveraged ETFs heighten volatility, and the company faces wage ballots and a rejected KEPCO prepayment.
SK hynix Signed LOI With OpenAI
: OpenAI signed LOI with SK hynix (000660) to supply memory for its Stargate AI infrastructure, discussing up to 900,000 DRAM wafer starts/month; no pricing or market-share details disclosed.
: Analyst raised SK hynix (000660) target and kept Buy, citing stronger HBM demand and AI-chip adoption; projects DRAM price recovery and flagged recent share gains after the update.
: ProShares launched Ultra SK Hynix (SKHU), a 2x leveraged ETF tracking daily performance of SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (000660), listed on NYSE for traders seeking amplified daily exposure.
BOJ Warns On SK hynix ETFs
: Bank of Korea warns leveraged, overseas ETFs tied to SK hynix (000660) add volatility in Korea, cite AI-driven trading and spillovers; calls for tighter oversight ahead of Oct. 22 meeting
: SK hynix (000660) rejected KEPCO’s proposal to prepay ₩25 trillion in electricity fees over five years, citing internal reviews and uncertainty about long-term semiconductor demand.
: SK hynix ADR (000660): South Korean union will ballot members on a revised 2026 wage deal Sept 15–16 after narrowly rejecting the prior offer.
